suite: Production popup with browser API test adapter

checks.name: Production HTML, CSS and modules render without errors
Master switch pauses, remembers engine preference and resumes
Engine preference survives pause and popup reload
Save failure restores confirmed UI and rule state, then retries
Read failure disables controls and recovers via Retry
Keyboard Tab and Space operate labelled switches
320px and 380px layouts have no horizontal overflow and fit popup height
Reduced motion removes animation and transitions
About view discloses privacy, Web Guide limitation and returns
Japanese selection translates labels, errors and About; persists across reload
Language remains available while routing and spelling are paused
No uncaught UI JavaScript exceptions during all interactions

limitations: Uses production popup and controller modules in Chromium with a test adapter for chrome.runtime, chrome.storage and DNR.
Does not validate extension installation, real DNR APIs, browser profile persistence or live search-engine behavior.
